author: Temminck, 1830
status: 텃새 수백 마리 · 여름철새 수십 마리
summary: 우리나라 비둘기류 가운데 가장 큰 종으로, 울릉도와 남해안 섬에 사는 텃새이자 여름철새이다. 서남해에서는 2월 말부터 상록활엽수림에 둥지를 짓는데, 땅에서 평균 3.4m 높이에 주변 나뭇가지를 엉성하게 얹은 접시 모양이며 흰 타원형 알을 보통 1개 낳는다. 주로 상록활엽수 열매를 먹으며, 마가목, 덧나무, 우묵사스레피, 보리밥나무, 후박나무 열매를 흔히 먹는다. 국외에서는 일본, 러시아 동부, 산둥 지방, 타이완에 분포한다.

points.en: pearly green sheen on the hindneck

art.subject: Black Wood Pigeon (Columba janthina), adult (sexes alike), as seen in evergreen broadleaf forest on Ulleungdo and southern Korean islands: plumage sooty black overall; in sunlight the crown and shoulders show a metallic purple gloss, the hindneck and neck sides a pearly green sheen, and the back and breast a mixed green-and-purple sheen; in shade the whole bird looks black; flight feathers and the long tail dull black with no white or pale bands; bill slender, dark greenish-blue with an ivory to pale yellow tip; brown eye; red legs and feet.
art.pose: perched in an evergreen tree, side view, reaching for berries
art.scene: evergreen broadleaf forest on a Korean southern island, dense glossy foliage; no people, buildings or text
views: adult in sunlight, side view perched on an evergreen branch: sooty black bird with purple gloss on crown and shoulders, pearly green sheen on the hindneck, dark bill with a pale tip, red legs, long dark tail
adult in shade, side view perched: looks wholly black and glossless, long tail, red legs the only colour
juvenile, head and neck detail in side view: dull sooty-black head and hindneck without the green gloss, duller than the adult
art.build: Large, heavy pigeon, about 40cm, the largest pigeon in Korea and clearly bigger than a feral pigeon, with a relatively small head, full chest and a long, broad, slightly rounded tail. Bill slender, shorter than the head. Legs short and red. At rest the wingtips fall well short of the tail tip. Flight strong with deep wingbeats; the long tail is often slightly fanned; no white anywhere on the wings or tail.
avoid: Do not paint grey plumage, a white neck patch or white wing patches like Common Wood Pigeon or a feral pigeon.
Do not paint pink or grey legs; adult legs are red.
Do not make it small and dove-like (Oriental Turtle Dove); it is a big, long-tailed pigeon.
Do not paint black wing-bars or a pale rump.
